title: placeholder-like text in a url and in headers stays literal
rationale: Expansion is defined for args, env and cwd only. A client that expands a url here rewrites the endpoint a package declared.
quote: Clients MUST NOT perform placeholder or environment-variable expansion in `url`, header names, or header values.
observabilityNote: The load report shows the entry was accepted. It cannot show the url a client would connect to, so a client that declines to activate an entry carrying placeholder-like text rather than risk expanding it also passes.
